question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Later**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 In the Second line of the passage:

 
 
• 
 *'Raman asked him to leave the poems with him and promised to read them'*
 
 
• 
 'Later' would be the correct option as it is used to refer to a time or situation that comes after the present one.
 
 
 
 
• 
 The correct sentence, *'Raman asked him to leave the poems with him and promised to read them **later**.'*
 
 
• 
 Therefore, the correct answer is '**Later**'.
 
 
• 
 Hence, the correct option is **1**.
 

Correct Paragraph__: *A poet visited Tenali Raman hoping to impress him with some poems he had written. Raman asked __him__ to leave the poems with him and promised to read them __**later**__. The man, however, insisted on (3) ______ out the poems to him. As the poet droned (4) ______ Raman fell asleep. When he woke up, the poet asked: “Sir, shall I read the (5) ______ again?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• 
 गद्यांश की **दूसरी** पंक्ति में:

 
 
• 
 'रमन ने उन्हें कविताएँ अपने पास छोड़ने के लिए कहा और उन्हें पढ़ने का वादा किया'
 
 
• 
 'later' सही विकल्प होगा क्योंकि इसका उपयोग वर्तमान समय के बाद आने वाले समय या स्थिति को संदर्भित करने के लिए किया जाता है।
 
 
 
 
• 
 सही वाक्य, *'Raman asked him to leave the poems with him and promised to read them later.'*
 
 
• 
 इसलिए, सही उत्तर **'बाद में'** (Later) है।
 
 
• 
 अत: सही विकल्प **1** है।
 

4a:T2065,
The correct answer is **Reading**.
